articles.title: A First-Hour Playbook for a Refrigeration Controller Alert
articles.excerpt: A First-Hour Playbook for a Refrigeration Controller Alert Most security teams have a playbook for a compromised server and none for a compromised refrigerator. The CERT-FR alert shows what the first…
articles.body: A First-Hour Playbook for a Refrigeration Controller Alert Most security teams have a playbook for a compromised server and none for a compromised refrigerator. The CERT-FR alert shows what the first hours look like when the assets are cold-chain controllers, and the sequence differs from a typical host incident. Hour one: confirm scope without touching the plant Before isolating anything, establish what the site actually runs. A controller family from Danfoss, Copeland or Dixell, with a model and firmware version, is the minimum. CERT-FR's alert names AK-SM and AK-SC on the Danfoss side and XWEB on the Copeland and Dixell side. Removing a controller from the network protects the network.

articles.title: SMS OTP Delivery Failure Budget (Carrier Filtering on Shared Routes)
articles.excerpt: Route a healthtech contact form only after the phone challenge reaches a terminal result, and preserve the form while it does. SMS OTP delivery can fail for ordinary reasons: an unregistered sender, c…
articles.body: Route a healthtech contact form only after the phone challenge reaches a terminal result, and preserve the form while it does. SMS OTP delivery can fail for ordinary reasons: an unregistered sender, carrier filtering, a handset problem, or a temporary routing delay. The useful design is a recoverable queue, not an optimistic send() call followed by a timer. My decision rule is blunt: delivery reliability beats integration polish. Register the sender for the launch markets, poll delivery state, rate-limit resends, and keep a separately engineered fallback. An accepted API request is not proof that a code appeared on the patient's phone. Short answer: make verification an explicit gate before assigning the contact to billing, clinical support, records, or another queue.

articles.title: Sci-fi legend Alan Dean Foster on his new futuristic adventure 'Lost On Paradise': 'It's paradise until you get there, and then maybe you mess it up' (interview)
articles.excerpt: 'Maybe Paradise isn’t always Paradise.'
articles.body: Few names in the science fiction literary world carry as much weight and respect as author Alan Dean Foster. His award-winning 55-year career as a grandmaster of the genre continues with his latest novel from Blackstone Publishing, " Lost on Paradise ", and we have an exclusive excerpt to share with our readers ahead of its release this week. Foster famously ghost-wrote the first " Star Wars " novelization for George Lucas in 1976 and "Splinter of the Mind’s Eye" in 1978, which was intended to be a low-budget Star Wars sequel should the space opera not become a hit. He’s been a mainstay for go-to fantastic adventures featuring engaging characters, dynamic plotlines, and imaginative worlds for six decades.

articles.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
articles.excerpt: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attac…
articles.body: Expect to see quite a few websites serving error pages today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild. Image: Shutterstock.com, Sashkin. The flaws at issue are present in PHP , the programming language that powers sites running on a large number of web publishing systems, including Drupal , Magento , Joomla and WordPress . Earlier today, PHP released an emergency security update to fix two critical bugs that can allow an attacker to execute code of their choosing on a vulnerable server.
